title: Nordic Style Kitchen
overview: A majestic modern kitchen showcasing clean geometric lines, high-performance appliances, and luxury finishes. The space is optimized for both culinary excellence and social gathering, featuring a seamless blend of natural oak and engineered stone.

process.title: Concept & Layout
process.desc: Spatial planning, 3D visualization, and material mood boards.

process.title: Execution
process.desc: Custom cabinetry construction, plumbing, and electrical routing.

process.title: Finishing
process.desc: Appliance installation, final polishing, and quality inspection.

title: Royal Master Bedroom
overview: A palatial bedroom design with plush velvet headboards, custom brass accents, and ambient cove lighting. Designed to be a serene sanctuary away from the city noise, focusing on acoustic dampening and soft material palettes.

process.title: Spatial Design
process.desc: Optimizing floor space for a walk-in wardrobe and seating area.

process.title: Material Sourcing
process.desc: Procuring premium fabrics, veneers, and brass fittings.

process.title: Installation
process.desc: On-site assembly, lighting integration, and final styling.

title: Aura Premium Bathroom
overview: Spa-like luxury bathroom featuring a freestanding bathtub, fluted wall panels, and brushed gold fixtures. The design emphasizes tranquility and hygiene through the use of large-format antimicrobial tiles and seamless glass.

process.title: Plumbing & Waterproofing
process.desc: Comprehensive structural waterproofing and hidden plumbing.

process.title: Tiling
process.desc: Precision cutting and installation of large-format slabs.

process.title: Fixtures
process.desc: Mounting of high-end sanitaryware and ambient lighting.
